name: tempcontrol
description: Sleep temperature platform: learns each sleeper's ideal bedroom temperature from their wearable and drives the thermostat through the night.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tempcontrol/server" "npm run dev -w @tempcontrol/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
